name: mksh

source.license: BSD-like/MIT/Unicode-DFS/legacy_notice; see imported NOTICE and Android.bp license block

notes: Android external/mksh has been imported under shell/mksh/src.
Keep upstream source separate from project-owned CRT/PAL glue.
The CMake integration follows Android.bp source and cflag choices and builds a separate crt_mksh artifact before replacing /system/bin/sh.
Windows builds define MKSH_CRT_ALLOW_LLP64 and carry a guarded source adjustment because mksh assumes pointer-sized values fit in long, which is false on Windows x86_64 LLP64.
